description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Lists the signed-in user's CVs on techjobs.vn: the primary CV (used for job matching and referral requests) and their other CVs, each with a link to open it. Use it to pick a cv_id; read a CV's content with get_cv and rate it with score_cv.
name: list_my_cvs

kind.description: "tailored" = a copy tailored to one job.

outdated.description: The source CV was edited after the primary CV was last updated.

source_title.description: The other CV the primary CV was made from.

primary_cv.description: The CV chính: the one CV used for job matching and sent with referral requests.

title: List my CVs
